body:
Also closely related, experimenting more, I found out that by adding two `Test` instances using `add_child(Test.new())` on the parent, it doesn't notify `NOTIFICATION_PATH_RENAMED` at all!
Looking at the code, the function which is responsible to validate the new child's name and assign a unique new name, sets the name data directly, without triggering name changing effects:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/9c776068d6ed23acd0c78bfe534272d1d2a3a619/scene/main/node.cpp#L1527-L1535

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/9c776068d6ed23acd0c78bfe534272d1d2a3a619/scene/main/node.cpp#L1570-L1575

After testing this with the MRP following the steps with different `node_name_casing` values, i can confirm the bug.
Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200)
My outputs with the different settings values:
```
snake_case:
[New Test node]
[NOTIFICATION_PATH_RENAMED] '' renamed to 'Test'
[NOTIFICATION_PATH_RENAMED] 'Test' renamed to 'test'
'test' entered tree

[New Test node]

[NOTIFICATION_PATH_RENAMED] 'Test' renamed to 'test2'
'test2' entered tree
```
